segments.3: ...One more... Tainui Adjell's assassin is hiding aboard.
segments.4: He is the one who ordered Kirikov to infiltrate Japan.
segments.10: Yes. He is the one who ordered Kirikov to infiltrate Japan.
segments.12: We cannot possibly let him escape.
segments.13: Yeah. He will definitely come back before the ship reaches port.
segments.15: The assassin's identity has been found, though.
segments.18: Heh. How strange... We agree. I understand a little of what you are feeling.
segments.23: Kasuke and Ilyusha are not the culprits.
segments.25: I heard their conversation through the speaking tube. I released them. I wonder where they went. This evening's star attractions. What a shame.
segments.26: Medea races through the land of mist and lakes... fleet-footed beyond pursuit... and beyond, the curtain.
segments.30: Voysey? I killed him. Black was a slight miscalculation.
segments.31: There is one more. I will kill him too. I have laid hands on him again and again.
segments.32: You were close to Ilyusha. Anyone approaching the Russian Fog would suspect a man from British Intelligence. I am Times Adjell, a professional assassin of the Imperial Russian execution bureau.
segments.35: It is fiction. Reality. There is no need to bind yourself to a role assigned in a few minutes.
segments.36: I see. So you were bought by Ashby some time ago?
segments.37: You told Ashby that he was British Intelligence. He believed I was a mediocre detective.
segments.40: In Paris, I had you assigned to a dreary background investigation, did I not?
segments.41: I can provide you a wider intelligence network jointly operated by Britain and Japan. Then you can do more political work.
segments.42: Or else, get swept up in the shipwreck and let the fish eat your rotten corpse.
segments.44: Ashby was still young. A spy who used bombs was something unheard of.
segments.45: You really threw yourself into it, did you not?
segments.46: You handed Kirikov to Ashby as a source of disinformation so he could infiltrate the Japanese Empire. Excellent.
segments.47: Once I eliminate you, my mission is complete. Ilyusha Granzelius, you belong to the Emperor as long as you live. It seems you must choose death.
segments.48: Ha! What a comedy. You cannot bind a life with that nonsense, idiot.
segments.49: Fool. I am the last samurai of this century.
segments.50: Ilyusha, you are going to die too.
segments.54: No. A spy and a salesman are a bad match.
